create_JobConfig: create a JobConfig dataclass instance with auto-generated run name, timestamp, and metadata directories
build_SchedulerConfig: build a SchedulerConfig dataclass to set scheduler mode, distributed init method, and node count
create_SlurmConfig: create a SlurmConfig dataclass to configure memory, timeout, CPUs per task, and partition
